newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nedcor launches Internet banking.
newsitem.headline: Nedcor launches Internet banking.

text.p: Nedcor Bank Ltd announced on Thursday that it had become the first South African bank to offer a full, secure banking service on the Internet.

The service, to be known as NetBank, would enable clients with access to the World Wide Web to perform transactions ranging from interaccount transfers and third party account payments to balance statements and foreign exchange rate enquiries.
Chief executive officer Richard Laubscher said he was confident the security features the bank had implemented, in conjunction with The Internet Solution, were sound.
"Intensive scrutiny and testing by two firms of independent auditors has further reassured us that we can guarantee our clients total security," he said.
